Name: Aquarium Simulator
Description: Net Logo project simulating life in an aquarium.

Name: GeoCaching Utad
Description:
A location-based game developed in Unity and C#. Players explore real-world locations and complete a mini-game to uncover clues connected to geocaches.

The project combines mobile gameplay, location-aware exploration, and clue discovery in one experience.

Name: 3D Engine
Description:
A C++ 3D graphics project built with the OLC library. It loads and processes 3D objects, then renders them on screen.

The work explored the fundamentals of a rendering pipeline and low-level graphics programming.

Name: Speak2GPT
Description: Python app with STT/TTS for ChatGPT.

Name: Wholesalers
Description:
A C# client-server console application for organizing and processing requests related to broadband location ownership.

It uses gRPC, sockets, and RabbitMQ to coordinate requests and responses between the system components.

Name: Business Intelligence & Data Mining
Description:
A business intelligence tool built around bakery sales data from CSV files to support decisions about sales and production.

It combines exploratory visualizations with linear regression, multiclass classification, and temporal forecasting workflows.

Name: AppLogger
Description:
A .NET observability system with an API for client applications to register and send their logs, plus a web dashboard for searching and monitoring those events.

Users can define alert rules and thresholds. When an alert is triggered, the system sends a notification to its configured webhook. The interface includes log exploration, health rules, alert status, and webhook management.

Name: RabbitMQ Server No SQL
Description:
A C# client-server integration project that uses RabbitMQ publish/subscribe messaging to exchange JSON data and connect with NoSQL databases.

A Swagger interface exposes the API endpoints for exploring and testing the service.
